decisions.choice: stretch out: stretch out the hand to seize
decisions.reason: The verb is used without its object, "hand", as it sometimes is (2 Samuel 6:6). Its form is unusual, and some read it as a slip for the usual form "you"; the sense is the same: Edom took part in the looting. "You too" in the second line means "you, of all people", the brother.

decisions.choice: do not (L); You should not have (B, R); disaster (all levels)
decisions.reason: As in verse 12, Balanced and Readable state the commands as condemnation. Every level keeps "disaster" at the end of each line, so the repetition can be heard (m1). Readable says "my people's city" for "the gate of my people", and "them" for "his", since Judah is meant.

decisions.choice: "calamidad" three times
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats 'ed, which sounds like Edom; Spanish cannot keep the sound, but keeps one word, "calamidad", all three times at every level, so the hammering repetition stays.

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple", and "{{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte" in verse 16
decisions.reason: The LORD is speaking (the meaning decision), and French puts the deity_pronoun span on God's own possessives throughout the prophets, where the English here has none.

decisions.choice: "재난" three times for *'ed*, at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes a play on the name Edom; Korean cannot copy the sound, but keeps one word in all three lines so the repetition stands.

decisions.choice: "ngày tai họa" three times at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats 'eydam (their disaster), a play on the name Edom (meaning decision); Vietnamese keeps the repetition with one word so the reader hears it.

decisions.choice: calamidade, at the end of each line
decisions.reason: Every level keeps one word, "calamidade", at the end of each of the three lines, as the English keeps "disaster", so that the repetition that sounds like the name Edom (m1) can still be heard. "Desgraça" is kept for the other word, "his calamity", in the second line.

source.text: וְאַֽל־תַּעֲמֹד֙ עַל־הַפֶּ֔רֶק לְהַכְרִ֖ית אֶת־פְּלִיטָ֑יו וְאַל־תַּסְגֵּ֥ר שְׂרִידָ֖יו בְּי֥וֹם צָרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And do not stand at the crossing to cut off his fugitives; and do not hand over his survivors on [the] day of distress.

en.L: And do not stand at the crossroads \q to cut off his fugitives; \q and do not hand over his survivors on the day of distress.
en.B: You should not have stood at the crossroads \q to cut down those who escaped, \q nor handed over his survivors on the day of distress.
en.R: You should not have waited where the roads meet to kill those who were running away. \q You should not have handed over the survivors to their enemies on that day of distress.

es.L: Y no te pongas en la encrucijada \q para exterminar a sus fugitivos; \q ni entregues a sus sobrevivientes el día de la angustia.
es.B: No debiste apostarte en la encrucijada \q para matar a los que escapaban, \q ni entregar a sus sobrevivientes el día de la angustia.
es.R: No debiste esperar donde se cruzan los caminos para matar a los que huían. \q No debiste entregar a sus enemigos a los que sobrevivieron, en aquel día de angustia.

fr.L: Et ne te tiens pas au carrefour \q pour retrancher ses fuyards ; \q et ne livre pas ses survivants le jour de la détresse.
fr.B: Tu n’aurais pas dû te poster au carrefour \q pour abattre ceux qui s’échappaient, \q ni livrer ses survivants le jour de la détresse.
fr.R: Tu n’aurais pas dû attendre au croisement des routes pour tuer ceux qui s’enfuyaient. \q Tu n’aurais pas dû livrer les survivants à leurs ennemis en ce jour de détresse.

sw.L: Wala usisimame njia panda \q kuwakatilia mbali wakimbizi wake; \q wala usiwatoe waliosalia wake katika siku ya dhiki.
sw.B: Hukupaswa kusimama njia panda \q ili kuwaua wale waliokimbia, \q wala kuwatoa waliosalia wake katika siku ya dhiki.
sw.R: Hukupaswa kungoja mahali njia zinapokutana ili kuwaua wale waliokuwa wakikimbia. \q Hukupaswa kuwatia waliosalia mikononi mwa adui zao siku ile ya dhiki.

ko.L: 갈림길에 서서 \q 그의 도망자들을 끊어 버리지 말아라. \q 고난의 날에 그의 살아남은 자들을 넘겨주지 말아라.
ko.B: 너는 갈림길에 서서 \q 도망하는 사람들을 죽이지 말았어야 했다. \q 고난의 날에 살아남은 사람들을 원수에게 넘겨주지 말았어야 했다.
ko.R: 너는 길이 갈라지는 곳에서 기다리다가 도망하는 사람들을 죽이지 말았어야 했다. \q 그 고난의 날에 살아남은 사람들을 원수에게 넘겨주지 말았어야 했다.

vi.L: Và đừng đứng nơi ngã ba đường \q để diệt những kẻ chạy trốn của nó; \q và đừng nộp những kẻ sống sót của nó trong ngày hoạn nạn.
vi.B: Ngươi không nên đứng nơi ngã ba đường \q để chặn giết những kẻ chạy thoát, \q cũng không nên nộp những người sống sót của nó trong ngày hoạn nạn.
vi.R: Ngươi không nên chờ ở ngã ba đường để giết những người đang chạy trốn. \q Ngươi không nên nộp những người sống sót cho kẻ thù của họ trong ngày hoạn nạn ấy.

pt.L: E não fiques na encruzilhada \q para eliminar os seus fugitivos; \q e não entregues os seus sobreviventes no dia da angústia.
pt.B: Não devias ter ficado na encruzilhada \q para abater os que escapavam, \q nem ter entregado os seus sobreviventes no dia da angústia.
pt.R: Não devias ter esperado no lugar onde os caminhos se encontram para matar os que estavam fugindo. \q Não devias ter entregado os sobreviventes aos inimigos deles naquele dia de angústia.

decisions.choice: the crossroads: a place where the road divides, where fugitives could be stopped
decisions.reason: The word is rare. It seems to mean a fork or a parting of the ways, where those fleeing Jerusalem would have to pass. Some take it as a narrow pass. Edom waited where the escaping people would come.

decisions.choice: hand over his survivors: deliver them to the enemy
decisions.reason: The verb means to shut up, and so to hand someone over into another's power (Amos 1:6, 9, where Philistia and Tyre hand over whole communities to Edom). Edom caught the survivors and gave them up to the conquerors.

decisions.choice: You should not have (B, R); to their enemies (R)
decisions.reason: As in verses 12-13, Balanced and Readable state the commands as condemnation. Readable says to whom the survivors were handed over (m2), and "where the roads meet" for the crossroads.

source.text: כִּֽי־קָר֥וֹב יוֹם־יְהוָ֖ה עַל־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ יֵעָ֣שֶׂה לָּ֔ךְ גְּמֻלְךָ֖ יָשׁ֥וּב בְּרֹאשֶֽׁךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: For near [is the] day of Yahweh on all the nations; as you have done, it will be done to you; your dealing will return on your head.

en.L: For near [is] the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} upon all the nations; \q just as you have done, it will be done to you; \q your dealing will return on your own head.
en.B: For the day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is close at hand for all the nations. \q As you have done, so it will be done to you; \q what you have dealt out will come back on your own head.
en.R: The day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is near for all the nations. \q What you did to others will be done to you. \q The harm you did will come back on you.

es.L: Porque cercano [está] el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} sobre todas las naciones; \q como tú hiciste, se hará contigo; \q tu obra recaerá sobre tu propia cabeza.
es.B: Porque el día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está cerca para todas las naciones. \q Como tú hiciste, así se hará contigo; \q lo que hiciste recaerá sobre tu propia cabeza.
es.R: El día {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} está cerca para todas las naciones. \q Lo que tú hiciste a otros se te hará a ti. \q El mal que hiciste caerá sobre ti.

fr.L: Car proche [est] le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sur toutes les nations ; \q comme tu as fait, il te sera fait ; \q tes actes retomberont sur ta tête.
fr.B: Car le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est tout proche pour toutes les nations. \q Comme tu as fait, ainsi il te sera fait ; \q ce que tu as fait aux autres retombera sur ta propre tête.
fr.R: Le jour {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est proche pour toutes les nations. \q Ce que tu as fait aux autres, on te le fera. \q Le mal que tu as fait retombera sur toi.

sw.L: Kwa maana siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [i] karibu juu ya mataifa yote; \q kama ulivyotenda, ndivyo utakavyotendewa; \q matendo yako yatarudi juu ya kichwa chako mwenyewe.
sw.B: Kwa maana siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} imekaribia kwa mataifa yote. \q Kama ulivyotenda, ndivyo utakavyotendewa; \q yale uliyowatendea wengine yatarudi juu ya kichwa chako mwenyewe.
sw.R: Siku ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} iko karibu kwa mataifa yote. \q Kile ulichowatendea wengine kitatendwa kwako. \q Madhara uliyoyafanya yatakurudia wewe mwenyewe.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 모든 민족에게 가깝기 때문이다. \q 네가 한 대로 너에게 행해질 것이고, \q 네가 한 일이 네 머리 위로 돌아갈 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 모든 민족에게 가까이 왔다. \q 네가 한 대로 너도 당할 것이다. \q 네가 남에게 한 일이 네 머리 위로 돌아갈 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 날이 모든 민족에게 가까이 왔다. \q 네가 남에게 한 대로 너도 당할 것이다. \q 네가 저지른 악한 일이 너에게 되돌아갈 것이다.

vi.L: Vì ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [đã] gần trên mọi dân tộc; \q ngươi đã làm thế nào, người ta sẽ làm cho ngươi thế ấy; \q việc ngươi làm sẽ đổ lại trên đầu ngươi.
vi.B: Vì ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã gần kề cho mọi dân tộc. \q Ngươi đã làm thế nào, ngươi sẽ bị làm lại thế ấy; \q điều ngươi gây ra sẽ đổ lại trên đầu ngươi.
vi.R: Ngày của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã gần cho mọi dân tộc. \q Những gì ngươi đã làm cho người khác sẽ bị làm lại cho ngươi. \q Điều ác ngươi gây ra sẽ quay lại trên chính ngươi.

pt.L: Pois perto [está] o dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} sobre todas as nações; \q assim como fizeste, será feito a ti; \q o teu proceder voltará sobre a tua própria cabeça.
pt.B: Pois o dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} está próximo para todas as nações. \q Como fizeste, assim te será feito; \q o que fizeste aos outros cairá sobre a tua própria cabeça.
pt.R: O dia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} está perto para todas as nações. \q O que fizeste aos outros vai ser feito a ti. \q O mal que fizeste vai voltar contra ti.

decisions.choice: the day of the LORD: the day when the LORD comes to judge
decisions.reason: The prophets speak of "the day of the LORD" as the time when God acts in judgment, against the nations and against his own people when they sin (Isaiah 13:6; Joel 1:15; Amos 5:18). Here Edom's day of judgment, "that day" of verse 8, becomes part of the LORD's day on all nations. The day Edom watched in verses 11-14 was Judah's; now the day is the LORD's.

decisions.choice: as you have done, it will be done to you: Edom will be repaid in kind
decisions.reason: The punishment matches the crime (compare Jeremiah 50:15, 29; Ezekiel 35:15). "Your dealing" is what Edom did to others, which will come back "on your own head", that is, on Edom itself (Joel 4:4, 7).

decisions.choice: the day of the LORD, at every level
decisions.reason: As set for the prophets, "the day of the LORD" is kept word for word at every level (Isaiah 13:6), so that the reader can follow the phrase through the books. Readable says "on you" for "on your own head".

decisions.choice: o dia do SENHOR; perto [está] (L), está próximo (B), está perto (R)
decisions.reason: "O dia do SENHOR" is the phrase of the prophets in Portuguese at every level (Isaiah 13:6, Joel 1:15), lowercase "dia", with the article inside the divine_name span. The words for "near" are those of Joel 1:15 at each level.

source.text: כִּ֗י כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֤ר שְׁתִיתֶם֙ עַל־הַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֔י יִשְׁתּ֥וּ כָֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם תָּמִ֑יד וְשָׁת֣וּ וְלָע֔וּ וְהָי֖וּ כְּל֥וֹא הָיֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For just as you have drunk on my holy mountain, all the nations will drink continually; and they will drink and swallow, and they will be as [if] they had not been.

en.L: For just as you have drunk on my holy mountain, \q all the nations will drink continually; \q they will drink and gulp down, \q and they will be as though they had never been.
en.B: Just as you drank on my holy mountain, \q all the nations will keep on drinking; \q they will drink and gulp it down, \q and be as if they had never existed.
en.R: Just as you drank on my holy mountain, \q all the nations will keep drinking the cup of my anger. \q They will drink it all down, \q and they will disappear as if they had never lived.

es.L: Porque como {{plural_you:ustedes bebieron|vosotros bebisteis}} en mi monte santo, \q así beberán continuamente todas las naciones; \q beberán y tragarán, \q y serán como si no hubieran existido.
es.B: Así como {{plural_you:ustedes bebieron|vosotros bebisteis}} en mi monte santo, \q todas las naciones seguirán bebiendo; \q beberán y tragarán, \q y serán como si nunca hubieran existido.
es.R: Así como {{plural_you:ustedes bebieron|vosotros bebisteis}} en mi monte santo, \q todas las naciones seguirán bebiendo de la copa de mi ira. \q Se la beberán toda, \q y desaparecerán como si nunca hubieran vivido.

fr.L: Car comme vous avez bu sur {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte, \q toutes les nations boiront sans cesse ; \q elles boiront et avaleront, \q et elles seront comme si elles n’avaient pas été.
fr.B: Comme vous avez bu sur {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte, \q toutes les nations boiront sans arrêt ; \q elles boiront et avaleront tout, \q et seront comme si elles n’avaient jamais existé.
fr.R: Comme vous avez bu sur {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte, \q toutes les nations boiront sans arrêt la coupe de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère. \q Elles la boiront jusqu’au bout, \q et elles disparaîtront comme si elles n’avaient jamais vécu.

sw.L: Kwa maana kama vile mlivyokunywa juu ya mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu, \q mataifa yote yatakunywa daima; \q watakunywa na kumeza, \q nao watakuwa kana kwamba hawajawahi kuwako.
sw.B: Kama mlivyokunywa juu ya mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu, \q mataifa yote yataendelea kunywa; \q watakunywa na kugugumia, \q na kuwa kana kwamba hawajawahi kuwako.
sw.R: Kama mlivyokunywa juu ya mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu, \q mataifa yote yataendelea kunywa kikombe cha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Watakinywa chote, \q nao watatoweka kana kwamba hawajawahi kuishi.

ko.L: 너희가 내 거룩한 산에서 마신 것처럼, \q 모든 민족이 계속해서 마실 것이다. \q 그들이 마시고 삼켜서, \q 전에 없었던 것처럼 될 것이다.
ko.B: 너희가 내 거룩한 산에서 마신 것처럼 \q 모든 민족이 쉬지 않고 마실 것이다. \q 그들이 마시고 들이켜서, \q 처음부터 없었던 것처럼 될 것이다.
ko.R: 너희가 내 거룩한 산에서 마신 것처럼 \q 모든 민족이 내 진노의 잔을 계속 마실 것이다. \q 그들은 그것을 다 들이켜고, \q 처음부터 없었던 것처럼 사라질 것이다.

vi.L: Vì như các ngươi đã uống trên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q mọi dân tộc cũng sẽ uống mãi; \q chúng sẽ uống và nuốt trọn, \q và chúng sẽ như thể chưa từng có.
vi.B: Như các ngươi đã uống trên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q mọi dân tộc cũng sẽ uống không ngừng; \q chúng sẽ uống và nuốt cạn, \q rồi sẽ như thể chưa từng có.
vi.R: Như các ngươi đã uống trên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q mọi dân tộc cũng sẽ cứ phải uống chén thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Chúng sẽ uống cạn, \q rồi biến mất như thể chưa từng sống trên đời.

pt.L: Pois assim como vocês beberam sobre o meu santo monte, \q todas as nações beberão continuamente; \q beberão e engolirão, \q e serão como se não tivessem existido.
pt.B: Assim como vocês beberam no meu santo monte, \q todas as nações continuarão bebendo; \q beberão e engolirão tudo, \q e serão como se nunca tivessem existido.
pt.R: Assim como vocês beberam no meu santo monte, \q todas as nações vão continuar bebendo do cálice da minha ira. \q Vão beber tudo até o fim, \q e vão desaparecer como se nunca tivessem vivido.

decisions.choice: you have drunk: "you" is now plural, and who is meant is not said
alternatives: the people of Judah, who drank the cup of judgment when Jerusalem fell
the Edomites, who drank in celebration on the captured mountain
decisions.reason: Until now Edom has been "you" in the singular; here the verb is plural. Read as Judah, the verse says that as God's own people drank the cup of his anger on Mount Zion, so all the nations will drink it now (Jeremiah 25:28-29; 49:12). Read as Edom, it says that as they caroused on God's mountain after its fall, so the nations will drink the cup of judgment. The Hebrew allows both, and the drinking of the nations is judgment either way.

decisions.choice: the nations will drink: the cup of God's wrath
decisions.reason: The prophets picture judgment as a cup of wine that God makes the nations drink until they stagger and fall (Isaiah 51:17-23; Jeremiah 25:15-29; 49:12, where Edom must drink it; Lamentations 4:21).

decisions.choice: swallow: gulp down
decisions.reason: The verb is rare. It seems to mean gulping down, drinking the cup to the last drop. Some take it as reeling or talking wildly, as drunkards do. In both readings the drinking ends in the nations' disappearance.

decisions.choice: the cup of my anger (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names the cup, which the verse implies (m2), so the reader can see that the drinking is judgment. It keeps "you drank" without saying who "you" are (m1).

decisions.choice: plural_you in this verse
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" turns plural here, so Spanish has a plural_you span, without saying who is meant, as the meaning footnote explains.

decisions.choice: "vous avez bu"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is now plural (the meaning decision), and French follows its number.

decisions.choice: "너희" for the plural "you" of this verse
decisions.reason: The Hebrew changes from singular to plural here, as the meaning decision says; Korean marks it.

decisions.choice: "các ngươi" (plural) in this verse
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" turns plural here, and who is meant is not said (meaning decision); Vietnamese marks the change with "các ngươi".

decisions.choice: "mlivyokunywa", plural
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" turns plural here, and Swahili shows it in the verb ("m-"); the English meaning decision says who is meant is not stated.

decisions.choice: vocês; o cálice da minha ira (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is plural here (m1), so Portuguese turns from "tu" to "vocês" without saying who is meant, as the Hebrew does. Readable names the cup as "o cálice", the word Jeremiah 25:15 and 49:12 use for it in Portuguese.

source.text: וּבְהַ֥ר צִיּ֛וֹן תִּהְיֶ֥ה פְלֵיטָ֖ה וְהָ֣יָה קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְיָֽרְשׁוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב אֵ֖ת מוֹרָֽשֵׁיהֶם׃

records.literal_gloss: And on Mount Zion will be escape, and it will be holy; and will possess [the] house of Jacob their possessions.

en.L: But on Mount Zion there will be escape, and it will be holy; \q and the house of Jacob will possess their possessions.
en.B: But on Mount Zion there will be survivors, and it will be holy; \q and the house of Jacob will take possession of what belongs to them.
en.R: But on Mount Zion some people will escape, and it will be a holy place. \q The people of Jacob will take back the land that belongs to them.

es.L: Pero en el monte Sion habrá escape, y será santo; \q y la casa de Jacob poseerá sus posesiones.
es.B: Pero en el monte Sion habrá sobrevivientes, y será santo; \q y la casa de Jacob tomará posesión de lo que le pertenece.
es.R: Pero en el monte Sion algunos escaparán, y será un lugar santo. \q El pueblo de Jacob recuperará la tierra que le pertenece.

fr.L: Mais sur le mont Sion il y aura des rescapés, et il sera saint ; \q et la maison de Jacob possédera ses possessions.
fr.B: Mais sur le mont Sion il y aura des survivants, et ce sera un lieu saint ; \q et la maison de Jacob reprendra possession de ce qui lui appartient.
fr.R: Mais sur le mont Sion, des gens échapperont, et ce sera un lieu saint. \q Le peuple de Jacob reprendra le pays qui lui appartient.

sw.L: Lakini juu ya mlima Sayuni kutakuwa na kuokoka, nao utakuwa mtakatifu; \q na nyumba ya Yakobo itamiliki milki zao.
sw.B: Lakini juu ya mlima Sayuni kutakuwa na watakaookoka, nao utakuwa mtakatifu; \q na nyumba ya Yakobo itamiliki kilicho chao.
sw.R: Lakini juu ya mlima Sayuni baadhi ya watu wataokoka, nao utakuwa mahali patakatifu. \q Wazao wa Yakobo wataichukua tena nchi iliyo yao.

ko.L: 그러나 시온산에는 피할 [곳이] 있고, 그곳은 거룩할 것이다. \q 야곱의 집은 자기들의 소유를 차지할 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 시온산에는 살아남은 사람들이 있고, 그곳은 거룩한 곳이 될 것이다. \q 야곱의 집은 자기들의 몫을 차지할 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 시온산에서는 몇몇 사람이 피할 것이다. 그곳은 거룩한 곳이 될 것이다. \q 야곱의 자손은 자기들의 땅을 되찾을 것이다.

vi.L: Nhưng trên núi Si-ôn sẽ có sự thoát nạn, và núi ấy sẽ là thánh; \q và nhà Gia-cốp sẽ chiếm hữu sản nghiệp của họ.
vi.B: Nhưng trên núi Si-ôn sẽ có những người sống sót, và núi ấy sẽ là thánh; \q nhà Gia-cốp sẽ chiếm hữu những gì thuộc về mình.
vi.R: Nhưng trên núi Si-ôn sẽ có người thoát nạn, và núi ấy sẽ là nơi thánh. \q Dân Gia-cốp sẽ lấy lại đất thuộc về họ.

pt.L: Mas no monte Sião haverá [os que] escapam, e ele será santo; \q e a casa de Jacó possuirá as suas possessões.
pt.B: Mas no monte Sião alguns escaparão, e ele será santo; \q e a casa de Jacó tomará posse do que lhe pertence.
pt.R: Mas no monte Sião algumas pessoas vão escapar, e ele vai ser um lugar santo. \q O povo de Jacó vai tomar de volta a terra que lhe pertence.

decisions.choice: escape: a place of escape, and those who escape
decisions.reason: The word means escape and also the people who escape, the survivors. Edom cut off Judah's fugitives (verse 14); now Mount Zion will hold survivors. Joel 3:5 takes up the same words: "on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as the LORD has said".

decisions.choice: it will be holy: Zion will again be the LORD's holy place
decisions.reason: The nations defiled God's holy mountain (verse 16); now it will be holy again, set apart for the LORD, and foreigners will no longer pass through it (Joel 4:17).

decisions.choice: their possessions: the house of Jacob will take back its own land
decisions.reason: With different vowels the same letters can be read "those who dispossessed them", so that Jacob takes possession of the peoples who had taken its land. The Greek translation reads it that way. The Hebrew text as written is followed; verses 19-20 describe Israel taking back its own land and more. This description of the Greek is written from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: the land that belongs to them (R)
decisions.reason: The word for possessions is used of an inheritance, especially of land (Deuteronomy 2:5, where the same root describes Esau's own land). Readable says "land" because verses 19-20 show that land is meant, and "take back" because it was theirs.

decisions.choice: no monte Sião haverá [os que] escapam (L); alguns escaparão (B); algumas pessoas vão escapar (R)
decisions.reason: The word means both escape and those who escape (m1). Portuguese has no noun for both, and "escape" is not said of people, so each level speaks of the people who escape, in the words of Joel 3:5, which takes up this promise: "haverá [os que] escapam" (L), "alguns escaparão" (B), "vão escapar" (R). "Ele será santo": Zion, "o monte Sião", is the subject.

source.text: וְהָיָה֩ בֵית־יַעֲקֹ֨ב אֵ֜שׁ וּבֵ֧ית יוֹסֵ֣ף לֶהָבָ֗ה וּבֵ֤ית עֵשָׂו֙ לְקַ֔שׁ וְדָלְק֥וּ בָהֶ֖ם וַאֲכָל֑וּם וְלֹֽא־יִֽהְיֶ֤השָׂרִיד֙ לְבֵ֣ית עֵשָׂ֔ו כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be [the] house of Jacob a fire, and [the] house of Joseph a flame, and [the] house of Esau stubble; and they will burn among them and consume them, and there will not be a survivor to [the] house of Esau, for Yahweh has spoken.

en.L: And the house of Jacob will be fire, and the house of Joseph flame, and the house of Esau [will be] stubble; \q they will set them ablaze and consume them, \q and there will be no survivor for the house of Esau, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken.
en.B: The house of Jacob will become a fire, and the house of Joseph will be a flame, and the house of Esau will be stubble; \q they will set them ablaze and burn them up. \q No survivor will be left to the house of Esau, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken.
en.R: Jacob's people will be a fire and Joseph's people a flame, and the house of Esau will be like dry straw. \q Jacob's people will set them on fire and burn them up. \q No one from the house of Esau will survive. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has said this!

es.L: Y la casa de Jacob será fuego, y la casa de José llama, y la casa de Esaú [será] rastrojo; \q los encenderán y los consumirán, \q y no quedará sobreviviente de la casa de Esaú, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hablado.
es.B: La casa de Jacob será un fuego, la casa de José una llama, y la casa de Esaú será rastrojo; \q les prenderán fuego y los consumirán. \q No le quedará sobreviviente a la casa de Esaú, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hablado.
es.R: El pueblo de Jacob será un fuego, y el de José una llama, y la casa de Esaú será como paja seca. \q El pueblo de Jacob les prenderá fuego y los quemará. \q Nadie de la casa de Esaú sobrevivirá. \q ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo ha dicho!

fr.L: Et la maison de Jacob sera un feu, et la maison de Joseph une flamme, et la maison d’Ésaü [sera du] chaume ; \q ils l’embraseront et la dévoreront, \q et il n’y aura pas de survivant pour la maison d’Ésaü, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé.
fr.B: La maison de Jacob deviendra un feu, la maison de Joseph une flamme, et la maison d’Ésaü sera du chaume ; \q ils l’embraseront et la consumeront. \q Il ne restera aucun survivant à la maison d’Ésaü, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé.
fr.R: Le peuple de Jacob sera un feu, et le peuple de Joseph une flamme, et la maison d’Ésaü sera comme de la paille sèche. \q Le peuple de Jacob y mettra le feu et la brûlera entièrement. \q Personne de la maison d’Ésaü ne survivra. \q C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui l’a dit !

sw.L: Na nyumba ya Yakobo itakuwa moto, na nyumba ya Yusufu mwali, na nyumba ya Esau [itakuwa] mabua; \q nao watawawasha na kuwateketeza, \q wala hakutakuwa na atakayesalia kwa nyumba ya Esau, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenena.
sw.B: Nyumba ya Yakobo itakuwa moto, na nyumba ya Yusufu itakuwa mwali, na nyumba ya Esau itakuwa mabua; \q watawawasha moto na kuwateketeza. \q Hakuna atakayesalia wa nyumba ya Esau, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenena.
sw.R: Wazao wa Yakobo watakuwa moto, na wazao wa Yusufu mwali, na nyumba ya Esau itakuwa kama nyasi kavu. \q Wazao wa Yakobo watawawasha moto na kuwateketeza. \q Hakuna hata mmoja wa nyumba ya Esau atakayenusurika. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema hivyo!

ko.L: 야곱의 집은 불이 되고, 요셉의 집은 불꽃이 되며, 에서의 집은 그루터기가 [될 것이다]. \q 그들이 그것을 불태워 삼킬 것이니, \q 에서의 집에는 살아남는 자가 없을 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말하였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 야곱의 집은 불이 되고, 요셉의 집은 불꽃이 되며, 에서의 집은 그루터기가 될 것이다. \q 야곱과 요셉의 집이 그것을 불살라 태워 버릴 것이다. \q 에서의 집에는 살아남는 자가 하나도 없을 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 야곱의 자손은 불이 되고, 요셉의 자손은 불꽃이 될 것이다. 에서의 집은 마른 짚 같을 것이다. \q 야곱의 자손이 그들에게 불을 붙여 태워 버릴 것이다. \q 에서의 집에서는 아무도 살아남지 못할 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 이렇게 말했다!

vi.L: Và nhà Gia-cốp sẽ là lửa, và nhà Giô-sép là ngọn lửa, còn nhà Ê-sau [sẽ là] rơm rạ; \q họ sẽ đốt cháy và thiêu nuốt chúng, \q và nhà Ê-sau sẽ không còn ai sống sót, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.B: Nhà Gia-cốp sẽ thành lửa, nhà Giô-sép sẽ là ngọn lửa, còn nhà Ê-sau sẽ là rơm rạ; \q họ sẽ đốt cháy và thiêu rụi chúng. \q Nhà Ê-sau sẽ không còn ai sống sót, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.R: Dân Gia-cốp sẽ là lửa và dân Giô-sép là ngọn lửa, còn nhà Ê-sau sẽ như rơm khô. \q Dân Gia-cốp sẽ châm lửa đốt và thiêu rụi chúng. \q Không ai thuộc nhà Ê-sau sẽ sống sót. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán điều này!

pt.L: E a casa de Jacó será fogo, e a casa de José, chama, e a casa de Esaú, [será] restolho; \q e eles os incendiarão e os consumirão, \q e não haverá sobrevivente para a casa de Esaú, \q pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou.
pt.B: A casa de Jacó se tornará um fogo, e a casa de José será uma chama, e a casa de Esaú será restolho; \q eles porão fogo nela e a queimarão por completo. \q Não restará sobrevivente da casa de Esaú, \q pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou.
pt.R: O povo de Jacó vai ser um fogo, e o povo de José, uma chama, e a casa de Esaú vai ser como palha seca. \q O povo de Jacó vai pôr fogo na casa de Esaú e queimá-la por completo. \q Ninguém da casa de Esaú vai sobreviver. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse isso!

decisions.choice: the house of Jacob and the house of Joseph: the whole people of Israel, south and north
decisions.reason: Joseph, the father of Ephraim and Manasseh, stands for the northern tribes (Amos 5:6; Ezekiel 37:16-19). With the house of Jacob beside it, the verse pictures the whole people reunited and acting together against Esau.

decisions.choice: fire, flame and stubble: a picture of swift, complete destruction
decisions.reason: Stubble, the dry stalks left after the harvest, burns at once (Exodus 15:7; Isaiah 5:24; Malachi 3:19). The brother who stood by while Jacob burned is now himself the fuel.

decisions.choice: for the LORD has spoken: the closing seal on the oracle
decisions.reason: The phrase marks a word as certain, because it is the LORD's (Isaiah 1:20; Joel 4:8). "No survivor" answers verse 14, where Edom handed over Judah's survivors.

decisions.choice: stubble (L, B); dry straw (R); survivor
decisions.reason: Readable says "dry straw" for stubble, which may be an unfamiliar word, and makes "they" plain as Jacob's people. Every level keeps "the house of Esau".

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말하였기 때문이다" (L), "…말했기 때문이다" (B), "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 이렇게 말했다" (R), without -시-
decisions.reason: The oracle's closing seal is God's own speech, as Joel 4:8.

decisions.choice: restolho (L, B); palha seca (R)
decisions.reason: "Restolho", the dry stalks left in the field after the harvest, is the word Exodus 15:7 and Isaiah use in Portuguese; Readable says "palha seca", as the English says "dry straw".

source.text: וְיָרְשׁ֨וּ הַנֶּ֜גֶב אֶת־הַ֣ר עֵשָׂ֗ו וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה֙ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְיָרְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־שְׂדֵ֣ה אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְאֵ֖ת שְׂדֵ֣ה שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וּבִנְיָמִ֖ן אֶת־הַגִּלְעָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will possess the Negev, [the] mountain of Esau, and the Shephelah, [the] Philistines; and they will possess [the] field of Ephraim and [the] field of Samaria, and Benjamin, the Gilead.

en.L: And [those of] the Negev will possess Mount Esau, and [those of] the Shephelah the Philistines; \q and they will possess the territory of Ephraim \q and the territory of Samaria, \q and Benjamin [will possess] Gilead.
en.B: The people of the Negev will take possession of Mount Esau, and the people of the Shephelah the land of the Philistines; \q they will take possession of the territory of Ephraim \q and the territory of Samaria, \q and Benjamin will possess Gilead.
en.R: People from the Negev desert in the south will take over Mount Esau. People from the western foothills will take over the land of the Philistines. \q They will take over the land of Ephraim \q and the land of Samaria. \q The people of Benjamin will take over Gilead.

es.L: Y [los del] Néguev poseerán el monte de Esaú, y [los de] la Sefela a los filisteos; \q y poseerán el territorio de Efraín \q y el territorio de Samaria, \q y Benjamín [poseerá] Galaad.
es.B: Los del Néguev tomarán posesión del monte de Esaú, y los de la Sefela, de la tierra de los filisteos; \q tomarán posesión del territorio de Efraín \q y del territorio de Samaria, \q y Benjamín poseerá Galaad.
es.R: La gente del desierto del Néguev, en el sur, se adueñará del monte de Esaú. La gente de las colinas del oeste se adueñará de la tierra de los filisteos. \q Se adueñarán de la tierra de Efraín \q y de la tierra de Samaria. \q La gente de Benjamín se adueñará de Galaad.

fr.L: Et [ceux du] Néguev posséderont la montagne d’Ésaü, et [ceux de] la Shéfela les Philistins ; \q et ils posséderont le territoire d’Éphraïm \q et le territoire de Samarie, \q et Benjamin [possédera] Galaad.
fr.B: Les gens du Néguev prendront possession de la montagne d’Ésaü, et ceux de la Shéfela du pays des Philistins ; \q ils prendront possession du territoire d’Éphraïm \q et du territoire de Samarie, \q et Benjamin possédera Galaad.
fr.R: Les gens du désert du Néguev, au sud, prendront la montagne d’Ésaü. Les gens des collines de l’ouest prendront le pays des Philistins. \q Ils prendront le pays d’Éphraïm \q et le pays de Samarie. \q Les gens de Benjamin prendront Galaad.

sw.L: Na [wale wa] Negebu watamiliki mlima wa Esau, na [wale wa] Shefela Wafilisti; \q nao watamiliki eneo la Efraimu \q na eneo la Samaria, \q na Benyamini [atamiliki] Gileadi.
sw.B: Watu wa Negebu wataumiliki mlima wa Esau, na watu wa Shefela nchi ya Wafilisti; \q watamiliki eneo la Efraimu \q na eneo la Samaria, \q na Benyamini atamiliki Gileadi.
sw.R: Watu kutoka jangwa la Negebu upande wa kusini watauchukua mlima wa Esau. Watu kutoka vilima vya magharibi wataichukua nchi ya Wafilisti. \q Wataichukua nchi ya Efraimu \q na nchi ya Samaria. \q Watu wa Benyamini wataichukua Gileadi.

ko.L: 네겝 [사람들은] 에서의 산을 차지하고, 스벨라 [사람들은] 블레셋 사람들을 [차지할 것이다]. \q 그들이 에브라임 들판과 \q 사마리아 들판을 차지하고, \q 베냐민은 길르앗을 [차지할 것이다].
ko.B: 네겝 사람들은 에서의 산을 차지하고, 서쪽 평지 사람들은 블레셋 땅을 차지할 것이다. \q 그들이 에브라임 땅과 \q 사마리아 땅을 차지하고, \q 베냐민은 길르앗을 차지할 것이다.
ko.R: 남쪽 네겝 사막의 사람들이 에서의 산을 차지할 것이다. 서쪽 산기슭의 사람들이 블레셋 땅을 차지할 것이다. \q 그들은 에브라임 땅과 \q 사마리아 땅을 차지할 것이다. \q 베냐민 사람들은 길르앗을 차지할 것이다.

vi.L: Và [những người ở] Nê-ghép sẽ chiếm núi Ê-sau, và [những người ở] Sơ-phê-la [sẽ chiếm đất] người Phi-li-tin; \q và họ sẽ chiếm lãnh thổ Ép-ra-im \q và lãnh thổ Sa-ma-ri, \q và Bên-gia-min [sẽ chiếm] Ga-la-át.
vi.B: Dân ở Nê-ghép sẽ chiếm hữu núi Ê-sau, và dân ở vùng đồi thấp Sơ-phê-la sẽ chiếm đất của người Phi-li-tin; \q họ sẽ chiếm hữu lãnh thổ Ép-ra-im \q và lãnh thổ Sa-ma-ri, \q và Bên-gia-min sẽ chiếm hữu Ga-la-át.
vi.R: Dân từ sa mạc Nê-ghép ở phía nam sẽ chiếm núi Ê-sau. Dân ở vùng đồi thấp phía tây sẽ chiếm đất của người Phi-li-tin. \q Họ sẽ chiếm đất Ép-ra-im \q và đất Sa-ma-ri. \q Dân Bên-gia-min sẽ chiếm Ga-la-át.

pt.L: E [os do] Neguebe possuirão o monte de Esaú, e [os da] Sefelá, os filisteus; \q e possuirão o território de Efraim \q e o território de Samaria, \q e Benjamim, [possuirá] Gileade.
pt.B: O povo do Neguebe tomará posse do monte de Esaú, e o povo da Sefelá, da terra dos filisteus; \q tomarão posse do território de Efraim \q e do território de Samaria, \q e Benjamim possuirá Gileade.
pt.R: O povo do deserto do Neguebe, no sul, vai tomar o monte de Esaú. O povo das colinas do oeste vai tomar a terra dos filisteus. \q Eles vão tomar a terra de Efraim \q e a terra de Samaria. \q O povo de Benjamim vai tomar Gileade.

decisions.choice: those of the Negev will possess Mount Esau: each region of Judah takes the land beside it
alternatives: they will possess the Negev and Mount Esau, the Shephelah and the Philistines
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is brief. "The Negev" and "the Shephelah" have no marker of the object, while "Mount Esau" and "the Philistines" do, so the first of each pair is taken as the people who will possess the second: the people of the Negev, Judah's southern desert, take Edom's mountains to the south-east, and the people of the Shephelah, the low hills to the west, take the Philistine plain. Read the other way, "they", the house of Jacob of verse 18, take all four. The picture is the same: the land is restored and enlarged on every side.

decisions.choice: Ephraim, Samaria, Benjamin and Gilead: the lands of the north and east
decisions.reason: Ephraim and Samaria were the heart of the northern kingdom, lost to Assyria in 722 BC. Benjamin lay just north of Jerusalem, and Gilead was Israel's land east of the Jordan. The verse pictures the whole land of Israel restored to its people.

decisions.choice: [those of] (L); the people of (B, R); the western foothills (R); the land of (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal brackets the words that show the reading taken (m1); Balanced and Readable state them. Readable explains the Negev and the Shephelah by where they lay, as Jeremiah 17:26 does at that level. "Territory" is the Hebrew "field", a stretch of land.

decisions.choice: "el Néguev", "la Sefela"
decisions.reason: The regions as Jeremiah 13:19 and 1 Chronicles 27:28 in Spanish; R says where they are, as the English R does.

decisions.choice: "네겝"; "스벨라" (L), "서쪽 평지" (B), "서쪽 산기슭" (R)
decisions.reason: The published Jeremiah forms (13:19; 17:26); Readable says where the regions lie, as the English does.

source.text: וְגָלֻ֣ת הַֽחֵל־הַ֠זֶּה לִבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֲשֶֽׁר־כְּנַעֲנִים֙ עַד־צָ֣רְפַ֔ת וְגָלֻ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּסְפָרַ֑ד יִֽרְשׁ֕וּ אֵ֖ת עָרֵ֥י הַנֶּֽגֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] exiles of this host of [the] sons of Israel, which [is] Canaanites as far as Zarephath, and [the] exiles of Jerusalem who [are] in Sepharad will possess [the] cities of the Negev.

en.L: And the exiles of this host of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel [will possess] what [belongs to] the Canaanites as far as Zarephath; \q and the exiles of Jerusalem who [are] in Sepharad \q will take possession of the cities of the Negev.
en.B: The exiles of this army of Israel will take possession of the Canaanite land as far as Zarephath, \q and the exiles of Jerusalem who are in Sepharad \q will possess the towns of the Negev.
en.R: This large group of Israel's people who were taken away as prisoners will take over the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath. \q And the people from Jerusalem who were taken away to Sepharad \q will take over the towns of the Negev.

es.L: Y los desterrados de este ejército de los hijos de Israel [poseerán] lo que [es de] los cananeos hasta Sarepta; \q y los desterrados de Jerusalén que [están] en Sefarad \q poseerán las ciudades del Néguev.
es.B: Los desterrados de este ejército de Israel tomarán posesión de la tierra de los cananeos hasta Sarepta, \q y los desterrados de Jerusalén que están en Sefarad \q poseerán las ciudades del Néguev.
es.R: Este gran grupo del pueblo de Israel que fue llevado prisionero se adueñará de la tierra de los cananeos hasta Sarepta. \q Y la gente de Jerusalén que fue llevada a Sefarad \q se adueñará de las ciudades del Néguev.

fr.L: Et les exilés de cette armée des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël [posséderont] ce qui [appartient aux] Cananéens jusqu’à Sarepta ; \q et les exilés de Jérusalem qui [sont] à Sepharad \q posséderont les villes du Néguev.
fr.B: Les exilés de cette armée d’Israël prendront possession du pays des Cananéens jusqu’à Sarepta, \q et les exilés de Jérusalem qui sont à Sepharad \q posséderont les villes du Néguev.
fr.R: Ce grand groupe du peuple d’Israël qui avait été emmené en captivité prendra le pays des Cananéens jusqu’à Sarepta. \q Et les gens de Jérusalem qui avaient été emmenés à Sepharad \q prendront les villes du Néguev.

sw.L: Na mateka wa jeshi hili la wana wa Israeli [watamiliki kile kilicho cha] Wakanaani mpaka Sarepta; \q na mateka wa Yerusalemu walioko Sefaradi \q wataimiliki miji ya Negebu.
sw.B: Mateka wa jeshi hili la Israeli wataimiliki nchi ya Wakanaani mpaka Sarepta, \q na mateka wa Yerusalemu walioko Sefaradi \q wataimiliki miji ya Negebu.
sw.R: Kundi hili kubwa la watu wa Israeli waliochukuliwa mateka litaichukua nchi ya Wakanaani mpaka Sarepta. \q Na watu wa Yerusalemu waliochukuliwa mpaka Sefaradi \q wataichukua miji ya Negebu.

ko.L: 그리고 {{gender:이스라엘 자손|이스라엘의 아들들}}의 이 무리 가운데 사로잡혀 갔던 자들은 사렙다까지 가나안 사람들의 [땅을 차지하고], \q 스바랏에 있는 예루살렘의 포로들은 \q 네겝의 성읍들을 차지할 것이다.
ko.B: 사로잡혀 갔던 이스라엘의 이 무리는 사렙다까지 가나안 사람들의 땅을 차지하고, \q 스바랏에 사로잡혀 간 예루살렘 사람들은 \q 네겝의 성읍들을 차지할 것이다.
ko.R: 포로로 끌려갔던 이 많은 이스라엘 사람들이 사렙다까지 가나안 사람들의 땅을 차지할 것이다. \q 스바랏으로 끌려갔던 예루살렘 사람들은 \q 네겝의 성읍들을 차지할 것이다.

vi.L: Và những người lưu đày của đạo quân này của con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên [sẽ chiếm] những gì [thuộc về] người Ca-na-an cho đến Sa-rép-ta; \q và những người lưu đày của Giê-ru-sa-lem [đang ở] tại Sê-pha-rát \q sẽ chiếm hữu các thành của Nê-ghép.
vi.B: Những người lưu đày của đạo quân Y-sơ-ra-ên này sẽ chiếm hữu đất của người Ca-na-an cho đến Sa-rép-ta, \q và những người lưu đày của Giê-ru-sa-lem đang ở Sê-pha-rát \q sẽ chiếm hữu các thành của Nê-ghép.
vi.R: Đoàn người đông đảo của dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã bị bắt đi làm phu tù sẽ chiếm đất của người Ca-na-an cho đến tận Sa-rép-ta. \q Còn những người Giê-ru-sa-lem đã bị đày sang Sê-pha-rát \q sẽ chiếm các thành của Nê-ghép.

pt.L: E os exilados deste exército dos filhos de Israel [possuirão] o que [pertence] aos cananeus até Sarepta; \q e os exilados de Jerusalém que [estão] em Sefarade \q tomarão posse das cidades do Neguebe.
pt.B: Os exilados deste exército de Israel tomarão posse da terra dos cananeus até Sarepta, \q e os exilados de Jerusalém que estão em Sefarade \q possuirão as cidades do Neguebe.
pt.R: Este grande grupo do povo de Israel, que foi levado como prisioneiro, vai tomar a terra dos cananeus até Sarepta. \q E o povo de Jerusalém que foi levado para Sefarade \q vai tomar as cidades do Neguebe.

decisions.choice: the exiles of Israel will possess the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath
alternatives: the exiles of Israel who are among the Canaanites as far as Zarephath, together with the exiles of Jerusalem, will possess the cities of the Negev
decisions.reason: This is the hardest verse in the book. It reads word for word "and the exiles of this host of the sons of Israel which Canaanites as far as Zarephath". It is taken here as a clause whose verb, "will possess", is understood from the end of the verse: the exiles of the north take the coast as far as Zarephath, and the exiles of Jerusalem take the Negev. It can also be read as one long subject, the exiles living among the Canaanites, so that both groups of exiles return to the cities of the Negev. "Host" may mean an army or a large company; some take it as a fortress or as a place name.

decisions.choice: the Canaanites as far as Zarephath: the Phoenician coast to the north
decisions.reason: Zarephath was a town on the coast between Tyre and Sidon, where Elijah stayed with a widow (1 Kings 17:9). "Canaanites" here means the Phoenicians of that coast.

decisions.choice: Sepharad: a place of exile not known for certain
alternatives: a place in Media or elsewhere in the east
decisions.reason: Sepharad is named only here. It is often identified with Sardis, the capital of Lydia in Asia Minor, whose name is written in a similar way in old inscriptions; others suggest places in the east. Later Jewish tradition took it to mean Spain, and the Jews of Spain and their descendants are still called Sephardim from this verse. The text says only that some of Jerusalem's exiles were there.

decisions.choice: [will possess] what [belongs to] (L); this large group ... taken away as prisoners (R)
decisions.reason: Literal brackets the words that the reading in m1 supplies; Balanced states them. Readable explains "exiles" as people taken away as prisoners and gives "host" as a large group, without choosing between army and company.

decisions.choice: "Sarepta", "Sefarad"; "los hijos de Israel" (L), no gender span
decisions.reason: Zarephath as 1 Kings 17:9 in Spanish and Sepharad as the terms note sets; "hijos" includes women.

decisions.choice: "Sarepta"; "Sefaradi"
decisions.reason: Zarephath as published in 1 Kings 17:9 and Luke 4:26; Sepharad is new, formed in the usual pattern.

decisions.choice: "Sa-rép-ta" (as Luke 4:26); "Sê-pha-rát"
decisions.reason: Zarephath keeps the published form; Sepharad, a place not known for certain, takes the terms-sheet spelling.

decisions.choice: Sarepta; Sefarade
decisions.reason: "Sarepta" is the town as 1 Kings 17:9 and Luke 4:26 name it in Portuguese. "Sefarade" writes the name, found only here (m3), as Portuguese spells its sounds.

source.text: וְעָל֤וּ מֽוֹשִׁעִים֙ בְּהַ֣ר צִיּ֔וֹן לִשְׁפֹּ֖ט אֶת־הַ֣ר עֵשָׂ֑ו וְהָיְתָ֥ה לַֽיהוָ֖ה הַמְּלוּכָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will go up deliverers on Mount Zion to judge [the] mountain of Esau, and will be to Yahweh the kingship.

en.L: And deliverers will go up on Mount Zion \q to judge Mount Esau, \q and the kingship will belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Deliverers will go up onto Mount Zion \q to rule over Mount Esau, \q and the kingdom will belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Leaders who rescue God's people will go up onto Mount Zion \q to rule over Mount Esau. \q And the kingdom will belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y subirán libertadores al monte Sion \q para juzgar al monte de Esaú, \q y la realeza será {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Subirán libertadores al monte Sion \q para gobernar el monte de Esaú, \q y el reino será {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Líderes que rescatarán al pueblo de Dios subirán al monte Sion \q para gobernar el monte de Esaú. \q Y el reino será {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et des libérateurs monteront sur le mont Sion \q pour juger la montagne d’Ésaü, \q et la royauté sera {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Des libérateurs monteront sur le mont Sion \q pour gouverner la montagne d’Ésaü, \q et le règne appartiendra {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Des chefs qui délivrent le peuple de Dieu monteront sur le mont Sion \q pour gouverner la montagne d’Ésaü. \q Et le royaume appartiendra {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na waokoaji watapanda juu ya mlima Sayuni \q kuuhukumu mlima wa Esau, \q na ufalme utakuwa wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Waokoaji watapanda juu ya mlima Sayuni \q kuutawala mlima wa Esau, \q na ufalme utakuwa wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Viongozi wanaowaokoa watu wa Mungu watapanda juu ya mlima Sayuni \q kuutawala mlima wa Esau. \q Na ufalme utakuwa wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 구원자들이 시온산으로 올라가서 \q 에서의 산을 심판할 것이고, \q 왕권이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 있을 것이다.
ko.B: 구원자들이 시온산에 올라가 \q 에서의 산을 다스릴 것이고, \q 나라가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이 될 것이다.
ko.R: 하나님의 백성을 구하는 지도자들이 시온산에 올라가 \q 에서의 산을 다스릴 것이다. \q 그리고 나라는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이 될 것이다.

vi.L: Và những người giải cứu sẽ đi lên núi Si-ôn \q để xét xử núi Ê-sau, \q và vương quyền sẽ thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Những người giải cứu sẽ đi lên núi Si-ôn \q để cai trị núi Ê-sau, \q và vương quốc sẽ thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Những người lãnh đạo giải cứu dân Đức Chúa Trời sẽ đi lên núi Si-ôn \q để cai trị núi Ê-sau. \q Và vương quốc sẽ thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

pt.L: E libertadores subirão ao monte Sião \q para julgar o monte de Esaú, \q e a realeza pertencerá {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.B: Libertadores subirão ao monte Sião \q para governar o monte de Esaú, \q e o reino pertencerá {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.R: Líderes que salvam o povo de Deus vão subir ao monte Sião \q para governar o monte de Esaú. \q E o reino vai pertencer {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

decisions.choice: deliverers: leaders who save the people, like the judges
decisions.reason: The word is used of the leaders God raised up in the book of Judges to rescue Israel (Judges 3:9, 15; Nehemiah 9:27). The Greek translation reads it with other vowels as "those who have been delivered", the rescued people themselves. The Hebrew text is followed. This description of the Greek is written from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: to judge: to rule and to bring justice
decisions.reason: The verb means to judge, and so to govern, as the judges of Israel did. Mount Esau, which looked down on Jerusalem (verse 3), will be ruled from Mount Zion. The two mountains frame the end of the book.

decisions.choice: the kingship will belong to the LORD: the book's last word
decisions.reason: The book ends not with Israel's victory but with the LORD's reign. The deliverers rule under him, and the kingdom is his (Psalm 22:29; Zechariah 14:9).

decisions.choice: deliverers (L, B); leaders who rescue God's people (R); judge (L); rule over (B, R); kingship (L); kingdom (B, R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "deliverers" (m1). Balanced and Readable say "rule over" for the sense of "judge" here (m2), and "kingdom" for the reign that belongs to the LORD.

decisions.choice: libertadores
decisions.reason: "Libertador" is the word the Portuguese of Judges 3:9 and 15 uses for the leaders God raised up (m1); "salvadores" would suggest the Saviour to a Christian reader.
